intro: We do not publish package prices for roofing, because anyone who does is guessing. What a roof costs depends on its pitch, its square footage, how many layers are already up there, the condition of the decking underneath, and whether an insurance claim is carrying part of it. What we can promise is how the number gets to you: we come out, we get on the roof, and we put a written estimate in your hand. There is no deposit to get one, no same-day-only pricing, and no pressure to sign while we are standing in your driveway. If a repair will do, we will tell you that even though it is the smaller job.
